description: Only films whose running time is strictly more than 112 minutes are included; a film of exactly 112 minutes does not count.

a.request: Looking only at films whose running time (`film.length`) is more than 112 minutes, for each language (`film.language_id`) give the language id, the average replacement cost (`replacement_cost`), and the average running time, ignoring missing values in each average (missing if none remain). Sort by average running time from highest to lowest, with missing averages last, show the top 10, and don't round.
a.sql:
SELECT f.language_id, AVG(f.replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost, AVG(f.length) AS avg_running_time
FROM film AS f
WHERE f.length > 112
GROUP BY f.language_id
ORDER BY avg_running_time IS NULL, avg_running_time DESC
LIMIT 10;

c.request: Using 112 minutes (`film.length`) as the cutoff for a long film and considering only the long films, for each language (`film.language_id`) give the language id, the average replacement cost (`replacement_cost`), and the average running time, ignoring missing values in each average (missing if none remain). Sort by average running time from highest to lowest, with missing averages last, show the top 10, and don't round. Only films whose running time is strictly more than 112 minutes are included; a film of exactly 112 minutes does not count.
c.sql: SELECT f.language_id, AVG(f.replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost, AVG(f.length) AS avg_running_time FROM film f WHERE f.length > 112 GROUP BY f.language_id ORDER BY avg_running_time IS NULL, avg_running_time DESC LIMIT 10;

d.request: Only films with `film.length` greater than 112 minutes are included; films of exactly 112 minutes are excluded. Group the films by `film.language_id` and return each language ID, the average `replacement_cost`, and the average `length`, ignoring missing values separately in each average and returning a missing average if no values remain. Sort by average `length` descending, with missing averages last, return the top 10, and do not round the averages.
d.sql:
SELECT language_id, AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost, AVG(length) AS avg_length
FROM film
WHERE length > 112
GROUP BY language_id
ORDER BY avg_length DESC
LIMIT 10;

b.request: For each language, consider only films with a non-NULL `length` strictly greater than 112 minutes. Return the language ID, the average non-NULL replacement cost, and the average non-NULL running time; each average is NULL if no values remain. Sort by average running time descending, with NULL averages last, and return the top 10 without rounding.
b.sql: SELECT l.language_id, AVG(f.replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost, AVG(f.length) AS avg_running_time FROM language AS l LEFT JOIN film AS f ON f.language_id = l.language_id AND f.length IS NOT NULL AND f.length > 112 GROUP BY l.language_id ORDER BY avg_running_time IS NULL, avg_running_time DESC LIMIT 10;
b.raw: For each language, consider only films with a non-NULL `length` strictly greater than 112 minutes. Return the language ID, the average non-NULL replacement cost, and the average non-NULL running time; each average is NULL if no values remain. Sort by average running time descending, with NULL averages last, and return the top 10 without rounding.
